prayerExcerpt.en-US: O God, who for the spreading of your Church crowned Saint Peter Chanel with martyrdom.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó Deus, que para expandir a vossa Igreja coroastes São Pedro Chanel com o martírio.

meta.face: A gentle Frenchman of about thirty-seven, clean-shaven, with a SOFT, SQUARE-JAWED face and full cheeks — a broad, smooth forehead, a straight, rather strong nose with a rounded tip, large, heavy-lidded dark-brown eyes under softly arched dark brows, a full, kindly mouth and a small dimple in the rounded chin; thick dark-brown hair parted on one side, a soft wave falling across the forehead and the hair covering the tops of the ears; a mild, patient gaze toward the viewer.
meta.basis: The devotional portrait on Wikipedia shows a young clean-shaven priest with a full, gentle face, side-parted wavy dark hair, a black soutane and cloak and a crucifix; he was killed on Futuna at 37. His companions remembered his unfailing gentleness, which the expression keeps.
